issue.title: Bug: LogAnalyzer misses rsyslog repeated imrelp session-broken message

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

LogAnalyzer already ignores the direct rsyslog imrelp session-broken
  message:

`  ERR rsyslogd: imrelp...error 'error when receiving data, session broken'...`

  Recent 202605 runs also emit the same condition in rsyslog duplicate-message
  reduction format:

```
  ERR rsyslogd: message repeated 2 times: [imrelp[2514]: error 'error when
  receiving data, session broken'...]
```

  The existing common ignore regex does not match the compressed
  "message repeated N times: [imrelp...]" form. As a result, tests fail during
  teardown even though the test logic itself passed.

### Steps to Reproduce

 Run affected tests on a 202605 dualtor-aa testbed where rsyslog is HUPed
  during the LogAnalyzer window.

  Example:
```

  ./run_tests.sh \
    -n dtAA \
    -m individual \
    -r \
    -t any,util,dualtor,t0 \
    -f ../ansible/testbed.yaml \
    -u \
    -c "pfcwd/test_pfcwd_cli.py::TestPfcwdFunc::test_pfcwd_show_stat"
```

  The same issue was also seen with:
`dualtor_io/test_link_failure.py::test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_downstream[active-active]`

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

 **Actual:**
  The test fails in teardown with LogAnalyzer because the compressed rsyslog
  message is treated as an unexpected ERR syslog line.

  **Expected:**
  The compressed repeated-message form should be ignored the same way the direct
  imrelp session-broken message is already ignored.

### Relevant log output

  "analyze_logs--<MultiAsicSonicHost ldp202>" exit code:"1"
  match: 1
  expected_match: 0
  expected_missing_match: 0

  Match Messages:
  2026 Jul 18 <IPV6>.136311 ldp202 ERR rsyslogd:  message repeated 2 times:
  [imrelp[2514]: error 'error when receiving data, session broken', object
  'lstn 2514: conn to clt <IP>/<IP>' - input may not work as intended
  [v8.2504.0 try https://www.rsyslog.com/e/2353 ]]

  Surrounding syslog:
  2026 Jul 18 <IPV6>.135799 ldp202 INFO systemd[1]: rsyslog.service:
  Sent signal SIGHUP to main process 1252 (rsyslogd) on client request.
  2026 Jul 18 <IPV6>.136512 ldp202 INFO rsyslogd:
  rsyslogd was HUPed

  Failure 2:
  dualtor_io/test_link_failure.py::test_active_link_admin_down_config_reload_downstream[active-active]

  JUnit:
  tests="36" failures="0" errors="1" skipped="28"

  Match Messages:

resolution.title: LogAnalyzer: ignore repeated imrelp errors
resolution.description:
### Description of PR

LogAnalyzer already ignores the direct rsyslog imrelp
 "error when receiving data, session broken" message.

  Recent runs can emit the same condition in rsyslog's duplicate-message
  reduction format:

`  ERR rsyslogd: message repeated N times: [imrelp...]`

  The existing ignore regex does not match this compressed form, so tests can
  fail in teardown with a LogAnalyzer error even though the test logic itself
  passed.

  This PR updates the common LogAnalyzer ignore regex to match both the direct
  imrelp message and the optional repeated-message wrapper.

Summary:
  Fixes #26641

### Test result

 Image : branch.202605-ars.3213bfab-buildimage.63f17ae505b85275482fef3274201014c07fed91-nightly-2026.07.15.21.40
 Failure Logs
[test_link_failure.xml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30488089/test_link_failure.xml)
[test_pfcwd_cli.xml](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30488098/test_pfcwd_cli.xml)

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
 Tests were failing in teardown because LogAnalyzer treated rsyslog's compressed
  duplicate-message form as a new unexpected ERR log. The direct imrelp
  session-broken message is already ignored, but the equivalent repeated form was
  not covered.

#### How did you do it?
Updated the common LogAnalyzer ignore regex for the rsyslog imrelp
  session-broken message to allow an optional:

  `message repeated N times: [`

  prefix before `imrelp`.

#### How did you verify/test it?

Verified the updated regex matches both forms:
  - `ERR rsyslogd: imrelp...error 'error when receiving data, session broken'...`
  - `ERR rsyslogd: message repeated N times: [imrelp...error 'error when receiving data, session broken'...]`

  Verified it does not match unrelated repeated rsyslog messages.

  Validated against failed 202605 logs where LogAnalyzer matched the repeated
  imrelp line, and against later passing 202605 runs for `pfcwd` and
  `dualtor_io`.
